title: 1996 Yugioh Dark Bat PSV-058 Yu Gi Oh Trading Card First 1st Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: 1996 Yugioh Dark Bat PSV-058 is a 1st Edition Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card featuring the character Dark Bat from the Yugi set. This common card is manufactured by Konami and has a regular finish. It belongs to the Attribute/MTG:Color of Darkness in the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.
